title: React Website Deploy Kaise Karein – Step by Step Guide
excerpt: Is guide mein aap seekhenge ki React application ko Vercel ya Netlify par free mein kaise deploy karein. Saath hi custom domain setup aur build fixes bhi samjhenge.

author.name: Siddhartha
author.bio: Full Stack Engineer & DevOps enthusiast passionate about React and scalable cloud applications.

imageAlt: React Website Deploy Kaise Karein Step by Step Guide on Vercel and Netlify

seo.metaTitle: React Website Deploy Kaise Karein – Step by Step Guide (2026)
seo.metaDescription: React website ko Vercel aur Netlify par free mein deploy karne ka aasan step-by-step Hindi guide. Learn GitHub connect, build configuration, and custom domain setup.

content:
## 1. Introduction

React ek popular JavaScript library hai jiska use karke hum fast aur interactive web applications bana sakte hain. Is guide mein hum step by step dekhenge ki React website ko free mein Vercel aur Netlify par kaise deploy karein.

Modern web development mein continuous deployment ka use hota hai. Jaise hi aap GitHub par naya code push karenge, aapki website automatically re-deploy ho jayegi.

---

## 2. What You Need

Is deployment guide ko follow karne ke liye aapke system mein ye basic requirements honi chahiye:

- [x] Node.js installed on your system (v18 ya latest)
- [x] GitHub account create kiya hua ho
- [x] Vercel account (free tier is sufficient)
- [x] A React project (Vite ya Create React App)

---

## 3. Step 1: Project Setup

Sabse pehle ek naya React project banayein ya existing project use karein. Vite use karna fastest tareeka hai:

```bash
# Check Node version
node -v

# Install Vite (if not installed)
npm create vite@latest my-app

cd my-app
npm install
```

Local development server check karne ke liye run karein:

```bash
npm run dev
```

---

## 4. Step 2: Build the Project

Deploy karne se pehle local build verify karna zaroori hai taaki production mein koi TypeScript ya syntax error na aaye:

```bash
npm run build
```

Aapke project root folder mein ek `dist` ya `build` folder generate hoga. Ye optimized static production bundle hai.

---

## 5. Step 3: Deploy to Vercel

Vercel React aur Next.js projects ke liye sabse fast aur seamless hosting platform hai:

1. Apna code GitHub repository mein push karein:
```bash
git init
git add .
git commit -m "Initial commit"
git remote add origin https://github.com/username/my-app.git
git push -u origin main
```
2. **vercel.com** par login karein aur **Add New Project** par click karein.
3. Apni GitHub repository select karein aur Import par click karein.
4. Build and Output Settings mein Framework Preset 'Vite' select karein aur **Deploy** button dabayein.

Sirf 60 seconds ke andar aapki website live URL par available ho jayegi!

---

## 6. Common Issues & Routing Fix

React Router (SPA) use karte waqt agar page refresh karne par **404 Not Found** error aata hai, toh project root mein ek `vercel.json` file banayein:

```json
{
  "rewrites": [
    { "source": "/(.*)", "destination": "/index.html" }
  ]
}
```

Ye code Vercel ko batata hai ki saari dynamic routing requests ko `index.html` par point kare.

---

## 7. Conclusion

Congratulations! Aapki React website successfully internet par live ho chuki hai. Aage aap custom domain connect kar sakte hain aur SSL certificate Vercel dwara automatically provide kiya jata hai.

title: Postman API Testing Tutorial for Beginners
excerpt: Postman ka use karke API testing kaise karein, is guide mein hum step by step samjhenge, collections, environments aur automated test scripts ke saath.

author.name: Rohit Verma
author.bio: QA Automation Specialist, Cypress champion and API testing researcher.

imageAlt: Postman API Testing Tutorial for Beginners Complete Guide

seo.metaTitle: Postman API Testing Tutorial for Beginners (Hindi Guide)
seo.metaDescription: Learn API testing with Postman step by step. Create requests, handle auth, set environment variables, and write automated assertions with Chai.js.

content:
## 1. What is API Testing?

API Testing backend services aur endpoints ki functionality, reliability, performance aur security ko verify karne ke liye ki jaati hai. Postman world ka sabse popular API platform hai jisme aap bina code likhe bhi RESTful requests trigger kar sakte hain.

---

## 2. Setting Up Postman

Sabse pehle Postman app download karein ya browser version use karein:

- Visit postman.com and sign up for a free workspace.
- Workspace create karein jisme aapke collections store rahenge.
- Environments setup karein (Localhost, Staging, Production URLs ke liye).

---

## 3. Creating Your First Request

Postman mein new HTTP Request banayein:

- **Method**: GET
- **URL**: `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1`
- Click **Send**

Aapko response body mein Status Code `200 OK` aur JSON data show hoga.

---

## 4. Writing Automated Assertions

Postman ke 'Tests' tab mein JavaScript syntax use karke automated assertions likhi jaati hain:

```javascript
pm.test("Status code is 200 OK", function () {
    pm.response.to.have.status(200);
});

pm.test("Response time is less than 500ms", function () {
    pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(500);
});
```

---

## 5. Conclusion

Postman API test runner se aap pure collection ko ek click mein run karke automated report generate kar sakte hain.

title: Grafana + Prometheus Setup for Monitoring (Beginner Guide)
excerpt: Is guide mein aap step by step seekhenge ki Grafana aur Prometheus ko Docker ke sath setup karke server metrics kaise track karte hain.

author.name: Siddhartha
author.bio: Full Stack Engineer & DevOps enthusiast passionate about React and scalable cloud applications.

imageAlt: Grafana and Prometheus Monitoring Setup with Docker Guide

seo.metaTitle: Grafana + Prometheus Setup for Monitoring (Beginner Guide)
seo.metaDescription: Step by step guide to setup Grafana and Prometheus using Docker Compose. Monitor CPU, RAM, and application metrics with alert rules.

content:
## 1. Why Infrastructure Monitoring?

Production servers par downtime aur performance degradation ko prevent karne ke liye real-time metrics tracking bahut zaroori hai. Prometheus time-series data scrap karta hai aur Grafana us data ko beautiful interactive dashboards mein display karta hai.

---

## 2. Docker Compose Configuration

`docker-compose.yml` file banayein:

```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana
    ports:
      - "3001:3000"
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
```

Run karne ke liye simple command execute karein:

```bash
docker compose up -d
```

---

## 3. Creating Grafana Dashboards

Browser mein `http://localhost:3001` open karein, default credentials `admin / admin` se login karein aur Prometheus data source configure karke pre-built Node Exporter dashboards import karein.

title: Google Search Console Indexing Issues Kaise Fix Karein
excerpt: Agar aapki website ke kuch pages index nahi ho rahe, to is guide mein Crawled currently not indexed aur Discovered issues solve karein.

author.name: DevLearn Editorial Team
author.bio: Curators of top tutorials, code walkthroughs, and industry testing methodologies.

imageAlt: Google Search Console Indexing Issues Kaise Fix Karein

seo.metaTitle: Google Search Console Indexing Issues Kaise Fix Karein (2026)
seo.metaDescription: Fix Crawled - currently not indexed and Discovered - currently not indexed errors in Google Search Console. Boost organic rankings with verified SEO checklist.
seo.focusKeyword: Google Search Console indexing issues fix

content:
## 1. Common Indexing Statuses

Google Search Console mein Page Indexing report check karte waqt developers aksar do common errors dekhte hain: 'Discovered – currently not indexed' aur 'Crawled – currently not indexed'.

---

## 2. Fixing 'Crawled - Currently Not Indexed'

Iska matlab hai ki Googlebot ne aapka page visit kiya lekin content quality ya thin content ki wajah se usko index nahi kiya. Isko fix karne ke liye:

- Article mein comprehensive H1, H2, H3 hierarchy banayein.
- Unique value add karein aur generic AI re-hashes avoid karein.
- Internal links add karein related articles se.

---

## 3. Sitemap.xml & Robots.txt Audits

Ensure karein ki aapka `/sitemap.xml` update hota rahe aur `/robots.txt` important pages ko disallow na kare.

author.bio: Full Stack Engineer & DevOps enthusiast passionate about React and scalable cloud applications.

imageAlt: Must Know Linux Commands for Developers Guide

seo.metaTitle: Linux Commands for Developers – Must Know (Terminal Cheatsheet)
seo.metaDescription: Essential Linux commands every software developer, DevOps engineer, and system admin must know. Master grep, find, htop, systemctl, chmod, and curl.

content:
## 1. File Navigation & Inspection

Daily backend engineering aur server debugging ke liye Linux terminal ki command mastering zaroori hai:

```bash
# Find text inside files recursively
grep -rnw '/var/log/nginx/' -e '502 Bad Gateway'

# Real-time tailing of log files
tail -f /var/log/application.log
```

---

## 2. Process & Memory Management

Resource hogging processes identify karne ke liye:

```bash
# Interactive process monitor
htop

# Memory status
free -h

# Disk space consumption
df -h
```

---

## 3. Network Troubleshooting

Port listening aur server connectivity check karne ke liye `netstat` ya `ss` commands ka upyog karein:

```bash
ss -tulpn | grep 3000
```
